domain-information: A Platform Manager monitors platform traffic and adjusts policies to improve user engagement
A Platform Manager analyzes sales trends to decide which categories to promote
A Listing Specialist reviews product submissions and approves items to ensure they meet quality standards
A Listing Specialist writes product descriptions and sets recommended prices to attract buyers
A Customer Support Agent resolves disputes between sellers and buyers and provides guidance on payment issues
A Customer Support Agent responds to inquiries about platform rules and account verification
A Seller creates a listing for a used item and uploads photos to showcase it effectively
A Seller updates an item’s availability and responds to buyer questions to facilitate a sale
A Buyer searches for items in their preferred category and adds favorites to a wishlist
A Buyer completes a purchase and leaves feedback to help future buyers make decisions

domain objects.name: Platform Manager
domain objects.description: person who oversees platform activity and adjusts overall policies

domain objects.name: Platform Traffic
domain objects.description: measure of user activity and engagement on the platform

domain objects.name: Policy
domain objects.description: platform rule or configuration set to influence user behavior

domain objects.name: Sales Trends
domain objects.description: data showing how items sell over time

domain objects.name: Listing Specialist
domain objects.description: person responsible for reviewing and improving product listings

domain objects.name: Quality Review
domain objects.description: evaluation process that checks whether a product listing meets standards

domain objects.name: Product Listing
domain objects.description: posted item with details for sale

domain objects.name: Item
domain objects.description: physical good being sold

domain objects.name: Photo
domain objects.description: image uploaded to represent an item

domain objects.name: Product Description
domain objects.description: text describing an item and its features

domain objects.name: Price Recommendation
domain objects.description: suggested price based on guidance or analysis

domain objects.name: Availability
domain objects.description: current sale status of an item

domain objects.name: Category
domain objects.description: classification that groups similar items

domain objects.name: Customer Support Agent
domain objects.description: person who resolves issues and answers support inquiries

domain objects.name: Purchase Dispute
domain objects.description: conflict between buyer and seller over a purchase

domain objects.name: Support Inquiry
domain objects.description: question or issue submitted to customer support

domain objects.name: Seller
domain objects.description: user who posts items for sale

domain objects.name: Messaging
domain objects.description: communication channel between users

domain objects.name: Buyer
domain objects.description: user who searches for and purchases items

domain objects.name: Item Search
domain objects.description: process or action where a buyer looks for listings

domain objects.name: Wishlist
domain objects.description: collection of saved product listings a buyer likes

domain objects.name: Purchase
domain objects.description: completed transaction between buyer and seller

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: buyer’s review after a purchase

associations.description: Listing Specialist creates and improves a Product Listing
Listing Specialist performs a Quality Review
Quality Review evaluates a Product Listing
Item Search retrieves matching Product Listings
Item Search allows adding listings to Wishlist
Purchase is tied to a Product Listing
Customer Support Agent resolves a Purchase Dispute
Seller is involved in a Purchase Dispute
Customer Support Agent responds to a Support Inquiry
